left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  LMNA+ [AND]  cases with pathogenic LMNA mutations for LMNA+ [OR]  and heart myocardial samples from the explanted hearts of LMNA+ [AND]  patients who are scheduled to undergo clinically indicated heart transplantation at the Papworth Hospital NHS Trust
-  DCMWT cases: patients with heart muscle failure  [AND] but with wild-type lamin gene

right.raw_text: Heart myocardial samples from the explanted hearts of DCMWT  [AND] patients who are scheduled to undergo clinically indicated heart transplantation at the Papworth Hospital NHS Trust

left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Needle-phobia that would preclude blood-letting
  -  Participants unwilling to consent
  -  Patients that have a conventional contraindication for cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)

right.raw_text: -  Patients that have had a blood transfusion  [OR] within the last month and patients having haemodialysis will be excluded
